title: Careful to be sure well sealed.
text: Careful to be sure well sealed.. Containers are very nice. Must be very careful on closing them up for moving them around. The numerous tabs required to be snapped would make you think that it is very well sealed but be careful to take the time (extended time) to make sure they connect and snap. Like the portion sizes.
